summary: The agreement includes broad indemnification, strict confidentiality, and termination rights with unspecified notice. Service Provider must perform services, return property, and correct defects. Payment terms and retainer are outlined but lack detail.

clauses.title: Mutual Indemnification
clauses.original: each Party shall indemnify, hold harmless, and defend the other Party ... against any losses, damages, liabilities, deficiencies, claims, actions
clauses.plain: Each party protects the other from third‑party claims.
clauses.negotiation: Limit indemnity to negligence, cap damages.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.original: The Service Provider acknowledges and agrees that all of the Client’s ... shall not, during the term ... disclose any Confidential Information
clauses.plain: Provider must keep client info secret.
clauses.negotiation: Define scope, add carve‑outs for public info, specify duration.

clauses.title: Termination
clauses.original: In the event of a material breach, either party may terminate this Agreement prior to the end of the term by providing ____ days’ written notice
clauses.plain: Either party can end contract on breach.

clauses.title: Inspection of Services
clauses.original: Any Compensation shall be subject to the Client inspecting the completed Services ... If any of the Services performed ... are defective ... the Cl...
clauses.plain: Client can inspect and require corrections.

clauses.title: Return of Property
clauses.original: Upon termination of this Agreement, all property provided by the Client must be returned by the Service Provider

clauses.title: Retainer
clauses.original: Client is required to pay a Retainer in the amount of $____ to the Service Provider as an advance

obligations.obligation: provide services, comply with laws, return documents, correct defects, return property
pay compensation, pay retainer, provide access

negotiation: Cap indemnity and clarify notice period for termination.
